_howTo: Well-known national student programs that Sudbury students (Laurentian, Cambrian, Collège Boréal and others) can use. Each one links to the program's official page.
They show on the Student page as ongoing programs: they never expire on their own. Delete an entry if a program ends.

Fields: title (what students get, short), store (who offers it), url (official page, https), description (one or two lines in your own words, no prices: they change), category, where (online, in-store or both).
Categories: grocery, food-restaurants, electronics, fashion, home, health-beauty, sports-outdoors, kids-baby, pets, automotive, entertainment, services, other.
Only add programs you've checked on their official page. Don't add local school deals unless the school or business publishes them.
After editing, run `npm run scrape:local` (or just push: the deploy does it).
